PostToolUse.command: echo '{"systemMessage": "⚠️  db/models.py was modified. Every schema change requires an Alembic migration.\nRun: docker compose run --rm app alembic revision --autogenerate -m \"<description>\"\nThen: docker compose run --rm app alembic upgrade head"}'
PostToolUse.linux:
python3 -c "
import json, sys
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
tool = data.get('tool', '')
input_ = data.get('toolInput', {})
file_path = input_.get('filePath', '') or input_.get('path', '')
if 'db/models.py' in file_path:
    print(json.dumps({'systemMessage': '⚠️  db/models.py was modified. Every schema change requires an Alembic migration.\nNext steps:\n1. docker compose run --rm app alembic revision --autogenerate -m \"<description>\"\n2. Review the generated file in alembic/versions/\n3. docker compose run --rm app alembic upgrade head'}))
"
